author: richburdon
principle: Don't add a wrapper/boundary (e.g. a Suspense boundary) at a call site when the component being wrapped already provides it internally.
fix_shape: remove the redundant boundary and rely on the one already provided

author: richburdon
principle: Use a DXN/Ref-based reference only for data that crosses a serialization boundary (e.g. a function-invocation system); pass in-process objects directly rather than forcing callers to wrap them in `Ref.make()`.
fix_shape: choose the reference type based on whether the call is in-process or serialized

author: wittjosiah
principle: Don't restate a requirement in a higher-level guide when it's already implemented and enforced by the underlying framework; only document what's relevant at that level.
fix_shape: remove the redundant guidance from the doc

author: wittjosiah
principle: Don't maintain a duplicate historical record (e.g. a running task log) of work already tracked by git history; keep a living doc as just the current state.
fix_shape: drop the ephemeral log section and rely on git history instead

author: dmaretskyi
principle: Before adding a new helper function, check whether the same result can be composed from existing library combinators.
fix_shape: remove the new helper and compose it from existing combinators instead

author: dmaretskyi
principle: Don't add a convenience shorthand for a pattern until it has shown up often enough to justify it; remove speculative helpers.
fix_shape: remove the premature abstraction and revisit only if the pattern recurs

author: dmaretskyi
principle: Do not modify code that is slated for removal as part of the same migration; leave it untouched since deletion will handle it.
fix_shape: revert the change to the soon-to-be-removed module

author: dmaretskyi
principle: Do not modify code that is slated for removal as part of the same migration; leave it untouched since deletion will handle it.
fix_shape: revert the change to the soon-to-be-removed module

author: dmaretskyi
principle: Keep a diff scoped to its stated purpose; remove unrelated or accidental changes (e.g. stray formatting or reordering from a bad merge) before submitting.
fix_shape: revert the unrelated changes so the diff matches the PR description

author: dmaretskyi
principle: When changing a serialization format, verify that any signed or hashed payload's exact bytes are unaffected, since a different encoding can silently break existing signatures.
fix_shape: audit the signed-payload construction for format-dependent fields before landing the encoding change

author: dmaretskyi
principle: Use the codebase's canonical field name for a concept everywhere, confining any necessary deviation for an external format constraint to only the code that requires it.
fix_shape: use the canonical name outside the constrained code path and isolate the exception

author: richburdon
principle: Use the design-system layout primitives (e.g. Container, Flex, Grid, ScrollArea) instead of raw `<div>` elements with utility classNames for structural layout.
fix_shape: replace the div/className layout with the appropriate primitive component

author: richburdon
principle: Expose an action (e.g. navigate) through the standard menu contribution mechanism for consistency, rather than attaching an ad hoc click handler directly to a UI element.
fix_shape: add the action to the menu contribution instead of a bespoke onClick handler

author: richburdon
principle: Co-locate a type with the hook/function it belongs to instead of moving it to a separate shared types file; prefer per-field doc comments over redundant top-level section comments.
fix_shape: move the type next to its hook and drop the unneeded top-level comment

author: richburdon
principle: Prefer simple, direct state updates (e.g. calling a context setter imperatively) over building a registry/contribution abstraction with nested hooks and cross-context side effects, when the simpler shape achieves the same result.
fix_shape: replace the registry/hook machinery with direct imperative calls to a context setter

author: wittjosiah
principle: A foundational/lower-layer package must not depend on a higher-layer UI package; that dependency belongs only in the app/storybook layer that consumes it.
fix_shape: remove the import from the lower-layer package and move the dependency to the consuming layer

author: wittjosiah
principle: Put personal/editor preference settings in user settings, not in the shared project settings file that affects every contributor.
fix_shape: move the preference to user-level settings and remove it from the project config

author: dmaretskyi
principle: Use the canonical default-instance factory instead of constructing a new instance directly when a shared default already exists.
fix_shape: call the provided default factory instead of constructing a new instance

author: richburdon
principle: Use the existing shared utility function instead of reimplementing the same logic locally.
fix_shape: import and use the existing utility

author: richburdon
principle: Define an explicit props type for every component instead of leaving props untyped or inferred inline.
fix_shape: add a named props type/interface for the component

author: richburdon
principle: Factor a distinct UI region (e.g. a toolbar) out into its own component/slot rather than leaving it inline in a large component.
fix_shape: extract the region into its own component the layout can place separately

author: dmaretskyi
principle: Use the existing shared test helper instead of re-implementing the same setup logic locally.
fix_shape: call the existing helper function

author: wittjosiah
principle: Remove a superseded tool's config/dependency once its replacement is fully adopted, rather than leaving dead config around.
fix_shape: delete the old tool config file

author: wittjosiah
principle: Don't add a CI step that duplicates work an existing step already does (e.g. full-repo lint when affected-only lint already runs); consolidate to avoid redundant execution.
fix_shape: remove or merge the duplicate check

author: wittjosiah
principle: Follow the established component-composition pattern's export conventions; don't export internal sub-parts that the pattern says should remain private to the compound component.
fix_shape: remove the export and keep the internal piece private within the module
